title: Verifiable Manifest Client — ENS → Walrus, in One TypeScript Call
summary: Build the off-chain side of the WalrusResolver pattern: an ENS name in, a typed JSON manifest out. One eth_call to the resolver, one HTTP GET to the aggregator, no IPNS round-trip in between. Generic over the manifest shape so the same function serves Uniswap token lists, dApp configs, and DAO metadata.
